c_bonus_beta_relationship.interpretation: c_bonus multiplies the entire base confidence radius, including the sqrt(lambda) S term. It does not separately multiply u_t, the CG inflation, or a nonzero centering certificate. In this linear audit bar_psi_t is exactly zero.

category_definitions.cg_solver_certified: The approximate CG widths used a pre-action uniform energy-error certificate and the corresponding bonus inflation.
category_definitions.ex_ante_theorem_certified: The executed action rule used only predictable pre-action quantities that satisfy the conditional theorem assumptions.
category_definitions.posthoc_theorem_event_verified: Teacher-aware numerical checks made after execution verify the recorded realized confidence event and inequalities on every evaluation run; they do not create ex-ante certification.
category_definitions.uncertified_diagnostic: A recorded quantity has no theorem-certification status; this includes evaluation-only fields and action-rule factors lacking a verified one-sided enclosure.
